column2: # Create a line graph comparing NFC lending rate, ECB policy rate, DFR, and inflation
title = "ECB Policy Rates, Euro-Area NFC Lending Rate, and Inflation",

"**Figure 0:** ECB policy rates, euro-area NFC lending rate, and HICP inflation.

",

"*Note:* The figure plots monthly euro-area data.
",

"The NFC lending rate captures the cost of borrowing for non-financial corporations.
",

"The ECB policy rate refers to the Main Refinancing Operations (MRO) rate.
",

"The Deposit Facility Rate (DFR) captures the interest rate paid on excess reserves.
",

"Inflation is measured as the annual HICP inflation rate.

",
